title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1982-05-23
lineage: Sbd Mcassette > DAT > CDR> CDR > EAC (secure mode) > SHN

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy Greek Theatre show captured on a crisp soundboard tape with Bobby’s front‑center guitar and standout jams like Scarlet > Fire, Estimated > Eyes and The Other One.
ai_review.review: The May‑23‑1982 performance is praised for its relentless drive, superb setlist flow and memorable long second‑set improvisations (Scarlet Fire, Estimated/Eyes, The Other One).  The SBD source delivers warm analog clarity; a few reviewers note Bobby’s guitar sitting high in the mix and an initially thin Shakedown vocal, but overall the recording is considered very good.

ai_rating.rationale: Across ~20 reviews the average rating is ≈4.35 /5 with consistent praise for both performance and sound quality; only a single low‑star review mentions minor flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, warm analog SBD tape; occasional mix imbalance (Bob’s guitar forward) and brief level quirks early in the set, but overall crisp and listenable.

poor_songs: Shakedown (weak vocal start according to one reviewer)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, flowing second set with seamless transitions into a rare 33‑minute Scarlet > Fire and an extended Estimated/Eyes/Other One sequence; double encore adds extra payoff.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar work is described as “on fire” and fast, vocals thin at the Shakedown start but strong thereafter; overall praised for melodic leads.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby's rhythm/lead guitar is highlighted throughout—funky on Shakedown, compelling harmonics on TLEO, and often sitting forward in the mix, adding a crucial counterpoint.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s organ/keyboard textures receive strong praise (“awesome ways to get his instrument into the mix”, “eager”, “blossoming maturity”).
band_member_comments.Drums: The dual‑drummer lock‑step is noted as solid and powerful, with drum solos described as a “pound‑fest”.
